answer_1.quote: We focus on the task of generating narrative summaries of the evidence directly... We used three LLMs to generate a total of 128 evidence summaries using four distinct prompting approaches.
answer_1.outputs: Narrative evidence summaries / draft systematic review sections

answer_4.quote: We interviewed 16 domain experts... During interviews, we presented participants with two LLM outputs... and asked them questions to elicit their thoughts on the potential uses and harms for each type of output.
answer_4.guideline: An interview guide was developed based on our research questions (see Appendix B) and used to steer semi‑structured interviews with experts.
